rules.text: H5 additions (highFiveNewClassSkillTree.xml) are core skills; make sure the bot knows them.
Temple Knight / Eva's Templar: Shield Strike 984 (40-85) needs a shield; damage plus GetAgro, 6 s reuse; the main tank attack.
Eva's Templar: Challenge for Fate 985 (83) is a frontal-fan taunt plus target lock, 45 s reuse.
Swordsinger / Sword Muse: Deadly Strike 986 (40-85) is the main SWS damage skill; works with sword, blunt, dagger, pole and dual; 5 s reuse.
Swordsinger: Battle Whisper 988 (46/52/60) is a 2 min self buff: P.Atk x1.05-1.15, crit damage and attack speed x1.05-1.10.
Wind Rider: Throwing Dagger 991 (80) is damage plus a 10 s slow (speed x0.2), 45 s reuse.
Wind Rider: Dual Blow 928 (83) is a blow skill with Lethal and needs a DUALDAGGER.
Moonlight Sentinel: Multiple Shot 987 (82) is a bow fan AoE (900 range, 60 deg cone, up to 8 targets), 12 s reuse.
Moonlight Sentinel: Death Shot 990 (83) is a big single-target bow shot, 12 s reuse.
Mystic Muse: Aura Blast 1554 (81) target AoE 15 s reuse; Aura Cannon 1555 (82) short-range (150) nuke 10 s reuse; Arcane Shield 1556 (83) takes 70 % of damage from MP for 10 s, 5 min reuse.
Elemental Summoner / Elemental Master: Dimension Spiral 1558 (40-85) is the summoner's own nuke, 900 range, 15 s reuse.
Elemental Master: Servitor Share 1557 (83) is a 20 min self buff that shares the owner's stats with the servitor.
Eva's Saint: Mass Vitalize 1552 (76) party heal plus poison/bleed cleanse (3 s cast, 9 s reuse); Mass Cure Poison 1550 (76) party poison cure.
Eva's Saint: Chain Heal 1553 (83) heals the lowest-HP members near the target for 30 % max HP; costs 4 Spirit Ore, 5 s reuse.
Bot logic built from the old .md files or classSkillTree.xml alone misses Shield Strike 984, Deadly Strike 986 and Dimension Spiral 1558.

81+ skills from guides (Hide, Wind Riding, Arrow Rain, Seven Arrow, Silent Mind, Star Fall, Enlightenment, Blessing of Eva, Turn to Stone, Song of Purification, Spirit of the Unicorn, Servitor Barrier, Touch of Eva, Anti Magic Armor and others) are not in this datapack: ignore them.
L2J replaces a buff with the same abnormalType when the new abnormalLvl is >= the old one, so a class buff can replace a 12 h board buff with a short copy or fail and waste MP [engine rule, verify].
Defense Aura 91 (PD_UP) collides with the board Shield: skip while board buffs are on.
Attack Aura 77 (PA_UP) collides with the board Might: skip while board buffs are on.
Spirit Barrier 123 (MD_UP) replaces the board Magic Barrier (same abnormalLvl 3): skip while board buffs are on.
Sprint 230 (SPEED_UP) collides with the board Wind Walk: skip while board buffs are on.
All SWS songs (2 min) collide with the 12 h board songs: never cast songs that the board gives.
Prophecy of Water 1355, Wizard Servitor 1347 and Final Servitor 1349 are MULTI_BUFF lvl 1 like Chant of Victory: never on a target that has Chant of Victory.
Elder/Oracle target buffs (Might, Shield, Wind Walk, Agility, Concentration, Mental Shield, Clarity, Wild Magic, ...) duplicate the board: never while board buffs are on.

Only self buffs with their own abnormalType need upkeep, e.g. Rapid Shot 99, Soul/Spirit/Blessing of Sagittarius 303/415/416, Combat Aura 982, Battle Whisper 988, Seed of Water 1286, Spirit Sharing 1547, Iron Shield 527, Mortal Strike 410, Focus Death 355.

Never auto-use (any Elf class): symbols / ground fields that consume a Battle Symbol 8875 or Magic Symbol 8876 with a 30 min reuse: Symbol of Defense 454, Symbol of Noise 455, Symbol of the Assassin 460, Symbol of the Sniper 459, Raging Waves 1421, Anti-Summoning Field 1424, Mass Recharge 1428.
Never auto-use: utility skills that cost items: Unlock 27, Summon Treasure Key 419, Quiver of Arrow A/S Grade 323/324 (only when out of arrows), Find Trap 623, Remove Trap 624.
Never auto-use: escape or travel: Return 1050, Party Recall 1255, Silent Move 221, Chameleon Rest 296, Fake Death 60 (emergency only, see Wind Rider).
Never auto-use: PvP-only: Cancellation 1056, Warrior Bane 1350, Betray 1380, Erase 1395, Block Wind Walk 1359, Detection 933, Mana Burn 1398.
Skills that root the caster are emergencies only: Ultimate Defense 110, Vengeance 368, Servitor Empowerment 1299 (roots the pet), Invocation 1430 (stuns self).

The guide's 76-85 table lists only the rows below; the other Silver Ranger rows (Stun Shot, self buffs Rapid Shot / Sagittarius, Rapid Fire, Vicious Stance, Entangle, emergency, never list) are not restated for 76-85.

rows.name: Lethal Shot
rows.trigger: Lethal Shot on every reuse (8 s, power 7698, half-kill). Order: Lethal Shot -> Double Shot -> auto-attack.

rows.name: Double Shot
rows.trigger: Double Shot after Lethal Shot.

rows.name: Hamstring Shot
rows.trigger: Kite: melee mob approaching, or a runner. 30 % slow for 60 s, 15 s reuse.

rows.name: Evade Shot
rows.trigger: Defensive damage: I'm being hit (HP < 70 %), or in a raid. Damage + self Evasion +6 for 30 s, 75 s reuse.

rows.name: Burst Shot
rows.trigger: 3+ mobs.

rows.name: Multiple Shot
rows.trigger: At 82: 3+ mobs. Multiple Shot is a 900-range 60 deg fan.

rows.name: Death Shot
rows.trigger: 83+: Death Shot on reuse (12 s).

rows.name: Focus Skill Mastery
rows.trigger: MP > 50 % only. MP drain.

rows.name: Symbol of the Sniper
rows.trigger: Never: Battle Symbol.

103.name: Mystic Muse
notes: Role: water nuker. Weapon: a magic weapon (blunt or staff).
Arcane Chaos is first among the debuffs because the guide says "before other debuffs".

The guide's 76-85 table lists only the rows below; the other Spellsinger rows (Surrender To Water, Ice Dagger, fillers, Frost Bolt, Sleep, Seed of Water, bursts, Aura Flash, never / obsolete lists) are not restated for 76-85.

rows.name: Hydro Blast
rows.trigger: Main nuke: spam Hydro Blast.

rows.name: Arcane Chaos
rows.trigger: Boss: raid or boss, before other debuffs. +30 debuff vulnerability.

rows.name: Ice Vortex
rows.trigger: Opener debuff: first cast on any mob that will take 3+ nukes. -20 water res + slows, 30 s, 15 s reuse, 6 s cast. Own abnormalType, so it stacks with Surrender To Water [DP].

rows.name: Ice Vortex Crusher
rows.trigger: Finisher: on reuse, after Ice Vortex has done its work (target < 40 %), or on mobs without a vortex. In this datapack it dispels the target's Ice Vortex when it hits [DP]: don't cast it right after the vortex. A guide uses Vortex -> Crusher as a PvP burst combo [G estranky].

rows.name: Light Vortex
rows.trigger: Holy: undead / dark mobs. Light Vortex = -30 holy res.

rows.name: Solar Flare
rows.trigger: Holy: with Light Vortex vs undead / dark mobs.

rows.name: Aqua Splash
rows.trigger: 3+ packed mobs: Aqua Splash.

rows.name: Diamond Dust
rows.trigger: Mobs on me (radius 200): Diamond Dust, which also slows 40 %.

rows.name: Throne of Ice
rows.trigger: DoT: single high-HP mob. 75 s reuse.

rows.name: Arcane Power
rows.trigger: On while HP > 60 % and a healer is present (or HP regen is enough). Off when HP < 50 %. M.Atk x1.3, MP cost x1.1, drains HP [DP]. Guides say use it sparingly [G estranky].

rows.name: Aura Blast
rows.trigger: 81: Aura Blast (target AoE, 15 s reuse). The guide gives no trigger.

rows.name: Aura Cannon
rows.trigger: 82: Aura Cannon (150 range, 10 s reuse). The guide gives no trigger.

rows.name: Arcane Shield
rows.trigger: 83: Arcane Shield when HP < 30 % and MP is high. 70 % of damage taken from MP for 10 s, 5 min reuse.

rows.name: Raging Waves
rows.trigger: Never: Magic Symbol, 30 min reuse.
rows.why: consumes a Magic Symbol (8876), 30 min reuse

104.name: Elemental Master
notes: Role: summoner. Owner rule: the summoner heals only its own servitor.
Cubics from 80: Life + Smart.

The guide's 76-85 table lists only the rows below; the other Elemental Summoner rows (pet heal / recharge / cure / buffs, Life and Aqua cubics, Transfer Pain, Spirit Sharing, Mass Surrender to Water, Servitor Empowerment, never / obsolete lists) are not restated for 76-85.

rows.name: Summon Magnus the Unicorn
rows.trigger: At 79: Summon Magnus the Unicorn replaces Merrow. The strongest damage pet [G estranky, ES thread]. Costs Spirit Ore over time.

rows.name: Final Servitor
rows.trigger: Pet burst buff: boss, elite or raid only. Final Servitor for a melee/hybrid pet, 20 Spirit Ore. 5 min, 60 s reuse. MULTI_BUFF: collides with Chant of Victory if the pet has it (0.2).

rows.name: Wizard Servitor
rows.trigger: Pet burst buff: boss, elite or raid only. Wizard Servitor, 10 Spirit Ore. 5 min, 60 s reuse. MULTI_BUFF: collides with Chant of Victory if the pet has it (0.2).

rows.name: Arcane Agility
rows.trigger: On while HP > 60 %; off below 50 %. Cast speed x1.2, reuse x0.9, MP x1.1, drains HP.

rows.name: Summon Smart Cubic
rows.trigger: At 80: Life + Smart (debuff removal) [G]. 38 Spirit Ore.

rows.name: Dimension Spiral
rows.trigger: Owner nuke: Dimension Spiral lv 15-24 on reuse.

rows.name: Servitor Share
rows.trigger: 83: keep Servitor Share up (20 min).

rows.name: Warrior Bane
rows.trigger: Never: strips enemy speed/haste buffs, PvP only.

rows.name: Anti-Summoning Field
rows.trigger: Never: Magic Symbol.

105.name: Eva's Saint
notes: Role: healer and recharger. Owner rule: heals only. No nukes, no CC, no transformations, and no board-duplicate buffs.
Recharge (1013) cannot target any class that also has Recharge (EE/SE/Bishop/Prophet...), and that includes the caster herself [DP cond].
All of the Elder heal priority still applies (its rows are included); Mass Vitalize goes first and Chain Heal second among the group heals, Greater Group Heal after them.
Only the Elder heal priority table carries over; the Elder slot table (Serenade of Eva, Invocation, optional buffs, never / obsolete lists) is not restated for 76-85.

rows.name: Vitalize
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 1: anyone < 30 %: Vitalize (from 48). 3 s cast, power 780 [DP].

rows.name: Battle Heal
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 1, before 48 (no Vitalize yet): anyone < 30 %: Battle Heal.

rows.name: Mass Vitalize
rows.trigger: At 76: 3+ members < 70 %, or the party is poisoned/bleeding. 3 s cast, 9 s reuse. Faster than Greater Group Heal: use it first, GGH second.

rows.name: Chain Heal
rows.trigger: At 83: 3+ members < 50 % in a cluster. 30 % max HP to the lowest members. 4 Spirit Ore, 5 s reuse.

rows.name: Greater Group Heal
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 2: 3+ members < 65 %: Greater Group Heal (from 48). 378 + HoT for 15 s, 7 s cast [DP].

rows.name: Group Heal
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 2, before 48: 3+ members < 65 %: Group Heal.

rows.name: Major Heal
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 3: tank or member < 60 % and Spirit Ore in the bag: Major Heal (from 56). Power 946, 5 s cast, 1 Spirit Ore per cast [DP]. Guides call it the best heal per MP [G l2vika].

rows.name: Greater Heal
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 4: member < 75 %: Greater Heal. 472 + HoT for 15 s [DP]. Don't recast on the same target while its HoT is running [G l2vika].

rows.name: Vitalize
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 5: member poisoned or bleeding: Vitalize if HP is also low.

when.text: the poisoned / bleeding member's HP is also low

rows.name: Cure Poison
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 5: member poisoned or bleeding (HP not low): Cure Poison.

rows.name: Recharge
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 6: nobody < 80 %, a non-healer has MP < 50 %: Recharge.

when.text: nobody below 80 % HP and a non-healer member has MP < 50 %

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.trigger: Elder heal priority (still applies): Priority 7: out of combat: Resurrection on dead members.

rows.name: Arcane Wisdom
rows.trigger: On while recharging or MP is tight and own HP > 70 %. Off when own HP < 50 %. MP cost x0.7, cast speed x0.9, drains HP [DP]. Guides recommend it for recharging [G estranky, l2vika].

when.text: while recharging or MP is tight

rows.name: Mana Gain
rows.trigger: MP support: cast once on the main recharge targets (mages) before recharging. +85 to Recharge received, 20 min, 150 s reuse.

when.text: on the main recharge targets (mages), before recharging

rows.name: Divine Protection
rows.trigger: Optional: raids with debuffs or dark/holy damage, out of combat. Default off (owner rule).

rows.why: overwrites the board Chant of Victory

rows.trigger: Never: Magic Symbol, 1 h reuse.
